context: Philips Manager Recognition Award — 750 Recognition points for Philips behavior 'Team up to win'. Awarded by Sundaresan Jagadeesan on 24 July 2019. Reason: contributions in 'Moving the needle' on Code Quality, resulting in cultural changes across the businesses in PIC (Philips India Connected).
raw_text: Congratulations! Dattatreya Vellal. You have been awarded 750 Recognition points for demonstrating the Philips behavior Team up to win. Thank you for your good contributions in Moving the needle on Code Quality, resulting in cultural changes across the businesses in PIC. Thanks for your great contribution. Keep up the good work. Sundaresan Jagadeesan.
